entry.title: How to validate emails properly in your app (beyond regex)
entry.summary:
Regex is not enough for email validation. A string can pass /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/ and still be completely useless — the domain doesn't exist, the mailbox is gone, or it's a throwaway address that will never convert. Here's what proper email validation looks like, and how to add it to your app in minutes. // This passes regex: "user@thisdoesnotexist12345.com" // domain has no MX records "test@mailinator.com" // disposable, will never convert "admin@yourcompany.com" // role email, useless for marketing "user@gmial.com" // typo, user will never get your email
